newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE TO FACE COMBINED SCOTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE TO FACE COMBINED SCOTS.

text.p: World record test try scorer David Campese will make his first appearance for Australia on their tour of Britain and Ireland against a combined Glasgow-Edinburgh XV in Glasgow on Saturday.
Campese, who won his 100th cap against Italy last week, has been named on the wing and will play outside the likely test centre combination of Daniel Herbert and Pat Howard.

In the forwards, lock David Giffin, impressive in Wednesday's 47-20 opening victory over Scotland A, is given a chance to book a test place while in the backrow the Wallabies field their first choice flankers and play Mark Connors at No 8.
Unavailable for selection were centres Jason Little and Richard Tombs, number eight Michael Brial and flanker Brett Robinson due to injury.

Australia: Joe Roff; David Campese, Daniel Herbert, Pat Howard, Ben Tune; David Knox, George Gregan; Mark Connors, David Wilson (capt), Daniel Manu, David Giffin, John Welborn, Richard Harry, Michael Foley, Andrew Blades.
